precedence: This continuous contract supplies the fixed denominators and current-list/context/evidence rules. Base numerical, label, distance presentation, error priority and completeness rules apply to each expanded current answer.

primary_current_list.requires: Each turn establishes its full current matching-pair list, distances and explicit completeness. Score the exact current truth for every turn independently.

auxiliary_context_reconstruction.eligible: An explicit reference to an earlier correct complete answer in this same episode, with all current additions, removals and distance changes, can be expanded and scored against current truth.

current_state_basis.eligible: Actual current reads or current version/dependency checks supporting reuse of previous results.
current_state_basis.insufficient: Previous answer text alone, without current state evidence, cannot support a claim of a complete current check.
current_state_basis.administrative_QA: Used only for input and execution binding. It cannot serve as consumer current-state evidence.

execution.episode_authority: New outer FINAL_TIMING covering input checks, owner startup, all turns, EDIT, close, originals, post-readback and OUTER_RESULT write/close.
execution.turn_authority: Actual consumer FINAL_TIMING, errors, final, public thread event and explicit resume binding.
execution.failures_retained: error/turn.failed, missing final, thread discontinuity, unexpected tool, original deadline, close and archive failures remain failures even when later content is correct.
execution.usage_failure: Existing consumer parser failure remains visible. Missing or ambiguous usage prevents a later token gate and does not change separate content judgment.

public_projection.order: Anonymous episode ID lexicographic order, original internal turn order retained.
public_projection.preserve: Exact confirmed final bytes, original error/message bodies, complete owner attempts and CLI tool events, native code/stdout and opaque JSON-looking strings.
public_projection.remove: Only identified administrative envelope group, timing, usage, argv, paths and global thread identities. Known global context IDs have episode-local stable aliases.
public_projection.limit: Tool content and preserved error messages can reveal route. This package does not claim perfect blindness.
